categories.label: Display
categories.about: Screens, resolution, scale, brightness and night light.

options.label: Resolution
options.desc: Pixels on the built-in screen. The native resolution is the sharpest.

options.label: Refresh rate
options.desc: How many times per second the screen redraws. Higher is smoother and uses more battery.

options.label: Scale
options.desc: Makes everything bigger on dense screens. 1.25× suits a 2560 × 1600 laptop.

options.label: Brightness
options.desc: Backlight of the built-in screen.

options.label: Night light
options.desc: Warms the colors after sunset so the screen is easier on the eyes at night.

categories.label: Sound
categories.about: Where the sound goes and how loud it is.

options.label: Output
options.desc: The device that plays the sound.

options.label: Volume
options.desc: Output volume. The top bar shows it as VOL.

options.label: Mute
options.desc: Silences every output. The top bar shows MUTE.

options.label: Microphone
options.desc: Input level of the active microphone.

options.label: Interface sounds
options.desc: Short sounds when you move through menus and confirm.

options.label: Wi-Fi
options.desc: Turns the wireless adapter on or off.

options.label: Network
options.desc: The wireless network in use. Saved networks connect on their own.

options.label: Wired
options.desc: Ethernet. Plug in a cable and it connects on its own.

options.label: VPN
options.desc: Adds a WireGuard or OpenVPN connection.

options.label: Airplane mode
options.desc: Turns off every radio: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

categories.label: Bluetooth
categories.about: Paired devices and pairing new ones.

options.label: Bluetooth
options.desc: Turns the Bluetooth adapter on or off.

options.label: K2 Keyboard
options.desc: Paired and connected. Battery at 64%.

options.label: Headphones
options.desc: Paired, not connected. Turn them on to connect.

options.label: Pair a device
options.desc: Makes this computer visible for 60 seconds so a new device can pair.

options.label: Interface scale
options.desc: Size of the YoRHa-OS interface, on top of the screen scale.

options.label: Top bar height
options.desc: Height of the bar at the top of the screen. The tabs and the dotted rule follow it.

options.label: Bar contrast
options.desc: How the texts of the top bar stand out from the wallpaper. High draws the texts darker, on a light plate over paper, and the clock heavier.

options.label: Vignette
options.desc: Darkens the edges and corners of full-screen menus and the desktop, like the game.

options.label: Background motion
options.desc: The arcs and beams that drift slowly behind the desktop.

options.label: Reduce motion
options.desc: Stops the ink sweeps and the blink of the selector.

options.label: Cursor size
options.desc: Size of the mouse pointer, in logical pixels.

options.label: Language
options.desc: Language of the interface. Applies to every menu after a restart of the shell.

options.label: Layout
options.desc: The keyboard layout. Accents work with dead keys on US International.

options.label: Caps Lock
options.desc: What the Caps Lock key does.

options.label: Repeat delay
options.desc: How long a key has to be held before it starts repeating.

options.label: Repeat rate
options.desc: How fast a held key repeats.

options.label: Shortcuts
options.desc: Every keyboard shortcut of the desktop, by area.

categories.label: Power
categories.about: Battery, profiles and what happens when idle.

options.label: Battery
options.desc: Charge of the internal battery. The top bar shows it as BAT.

options.label: Profile
options.desc: Trades speed for battery life.

options.label: Screen off after
options.desc: Idle time before the screen turns off.

options.label: Suspend after
options.desc: Idle time before the computer suspends.

options.label: Lid closed
options.desc: What happens when the laptop lid closes.
